name: Life Insurance Corporation of India
business_summary: India's largest life insurer (about 66% share of new business premium) by assets (Rs ~55 lakh cr), selling participating, non-par, ULIP, term, health and annuity products via ~14 lakh agents. Government owned 96.5% until an Aug 2026 OFS of Rs 31,552 cr raised public float to 10% (promoters 90.0% at Sep 2026). Q1 FY27 PAT Rs 13,492 cr (+23% y/y), VNB +61%. Large equity portfolio drives volatile reported profit. Targets mid-20% VNB margin and a higher non-par share; exploring health insurance and fintech.

cost_structure.note: liability duration; costs are benefits paid and commissions

exposures.mechanism: LIC's equity portfolio (~one-third of AUM; Rs 15 lakh cr+, model knowledge) drives realised gains (a large part of reported PAT: FY26 PAT Rs 57.4k cr) and the embedded value. +5 VIX pts ~ Nifty -3.5% -> equity AUM -Rs 50k cr; shareholders' share ~5-10% of par surplus plus solvency fund exposure; market-beta 1.2 -> -3.5 net.
FIIs only 1.55% (rose after OFS) so direct effect small, but newly widened float (10%) makes LICI a liquid index constituent: +US$5bn/qtr flows -> ~+1.5.
DIIs went 0.99% -> 6.18% after the Aug OFS; MF SIP/DII inflows (+10%) support absorption of any further govt sales and raise LIC's own equity gains: +2.5.

evidence.note: Government OFS Rs 31,552 cr; public float 10% (NiftyTrader); CEO: no fresh stake sale soon (ET Now 7 Aug)

exposures.mechanism: ~75% of AUM in G-sec/debt, mostly held to maturity (model knowledge): +25bp yield lifts reinvestment yield (+) but cuts EV via discount-rate/book MTM on the AFS slice (-). Net ~0, slight negative.
Hike raises bank FD rates (competition for savings products) and bond yields; positive for annuity/guaranteed product pricing. Net ~0.

66% market share in new business premium (screener) so household savings shift into insurance/MF raises premium base: +1 SSU -> NBP +4% -> VNB +5%; Q1 FY27 VNB +61% y/y (Business Standard); P/EV ~0.7 so +2.5.

evidence.note: Q1 FY27 PAT Rs 13,492 cr; VNB +61% y/y (Business Standard)

exposures.mechanism: Gold is the household-savings substitute for traditional endowment/par products; +8% gold (USD) raises gold demand and cuts savings flow to insurance by ~1%; empirical -1.34/SSU (t -1.6) is larger; shrunk to -0.8.
Proposed distribution reforms/commission caps (LIC sees limited impact) and product-margin caps; IRDAI tightening one step -> VNB margin -100bp -> ~-1.5%.

evidence.note: LIC sees limited impact from proposed insurance distribution reforms (Financial Express)

exposures.mechanism: GST exemption on individual life insurance premia and ITC allowance on group life/health (ET, 8 Oct 2026) lowers customer cost 18%; demand tailwind but ITC-driven margin neutral: +1.0.

evidence.note: ITC on group health and life insurance allowed (Economic Times)

exposures.mechanism: LIC Mutual funds/housing-loan exposure (LICHFL) small; minor equity-credit linkage via LICHSGFIN stake.
LTCG/STCG on equity is borne partly by LIC's realised gains; govt reportedly may revisit LTCG (ET 3 Nov, SBI chairman); a rise cuts post-tax gains: +1 step -> ~-1.5, a cut would be positive.

company_links.mechanism: Per +10% move in LICHSGFIN equity value: LIC's 45.24% stake (~Rs 13k cr) is ~2.5% of LICI's Rs 5.16 lakh cr market cap -> +0.25% per +10%.

private life insurers gaining share of VNB
LIC plans to raise its NSE stake (BusinessLine 30 Aug)
